items.question: Do I need special equipment?
items.answer: No. Many programs are built around bodyweight training. For programs that use weights, we tell you exactly what equipment you'll need before the workout starts.

items.question: I've never trained before — will this work for me?
items.answer: Yes. You tell us your fitness level in the intake form, and the first weeks are a gradual ramp-up, not maximum load from day one.

items.question: I've tried working out before and quit — why would this be different?
items.answer: People usually quit not from laziness, but from having to decide what to do every single time. DonatelleX removes that decision for you — the program is already mapped out for months ahead, all you do is open the app and follow it.

items.question: How long does a workout take?
items.answer: 40–90 minutes on average, depending on the program and the day — you see the full length before you start.

items.question: Will I be charged automatically when my period ends?
items.answer: No. Payment is one-time, only for the period you choose. When it ends, access simply stops — no automatic charges. Want to continue? You pay for a new period yourself, whenever you like.

items.question: What payment methods do you support?
items.answer: Cards and local payment methods via Stripe and PayPal, YooKassa for Russian cards and SBP, plus USDT payment through our own crypto wallet with automatic transaction verification.

items.question: Does the app work offline?
items.answer: DonatelleX is a PWA (Progressive Web App): the interface and previously viewed workouts are available offline, and your progress syncs once you're back online.

items.question: What languages does the app support?
items.answer: The interface is fully available in 10 languages: Russian, English, Español, Deutsch, Italiano, Українська, العربية, हिन्दी, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, Հայերեն — switch instantly in settings. The workout programs themselves are currently in Russian; the English version is already being translated.
